content: Cross-checked official product documentation shows table stakes are a transparent overlay that can annotate any application, freehand pen, highlighter, basic lines/shapes/arrows, text, eraser, undo/redo, clear, configurable colors and stroke width, plus quick screenshot/save. Zoom exposes the familiar toolbar vocabulary (Mouse, Select, Text, Draw, Stamp, Spotlight/Arrow, Eraser, Format, Undo, Redo, Clear, Save), while Epic Pen positions overlay drawing, screenshots, and hotkeys as core workflows. This supports a v1 centered on a fast presentation loop: invoke, draw, switch to pointer/click-through, clear or export.
